about.value: Explore Greenville’s creative art studio for all ages. We offer kids summer art camps, no-school day programs, birthday parties, adult paint & sip nights, art classes, team building and corporate events, seasonal craft classes, and fine arts workshops. Art is fun, social, and approachable, no experience needed.
